dialogues.speaker: Tuokko
dialogues.text: Hang in there, old sport... We'll get you some fresh oil once we get to the harbor.

dialogues.speaker: Tuokko
dialogues.text: That's right, the "Never Fade Away" has been with me half a lifetime. We were going to retire together last year, but well, even at this age, there's no rest for us...

dialogues.speaker: Tuokko
dialogues.text: You see, my daughter's getting married! In order to give her a proper ceremony, I've no choice but to take these creaking legs and put the old girl out to sea!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Do you need some help? I can ask around...

dialogues.speaker: Tuokko
dialogues.text: Thanks for the offer, but please don't ask! These are Fatui waters, and their supplies cost a fortune — just a can of engine oil sells for several times the going rate. I can't afford to fix her up around here...

dialogues.speaker: Tuokko
dialogues.text: I'm on this run to make some money, after all. A dozen more trips and I should be able to give my daughter a wedding to be proud of. *sigh* For the sake of keeping costs down, I've got no choice but to make life hard for my old mate.

dialogues.speaker: Tuokko
dialogues.text: Thanks, kind youngster, but there's no need to worry. Me and the "Never Fade Away" are old partners-in-crime — I've no doubt she'll pull through.

dialogues.speaker: Tuokko
dialogues.text: Thank you! If you hear of any good business, please do let me know. We're not picky!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: The sea around here is dangerous...

dialogues.speaker: Tuokko
dialogues.text: I know that, but I also know my old partner's got what it takes to pull through. Her cooling system might be on the brink, but we're in Nod-Krai, it's not exactly Natlan out here!

dialogues.speaker: Tuokko
dialogues.text: *sigh* It's all my fault — I never knuckled down when I was younger. Now I'm old, I'm realizing that time waits for no man. No matter what, I'm determined to give my daughter a proper start.
